summary: Frontend-only retest of GlicoTrack edit-flow regression (Expo/React Native web preview, 390x844). The iteration_2 HIGH regression is STILL PRESENT. The attempted fix (passing a unique 'ts' param + lastTsRef) does NOT work because the root cause is one level higher: router.navigate({pathname:'/', params:{editId,ts}}) from Storico does NOT update the URL params when Inserimento (`/`) is already the active tab route — the whole navigation is a no-op and NEITHER editId NOR ts changes. Verified by inspecting page.url after each step: after update-save URL is '/?editId=&ts=179...719'; after tapping edit-button on the SECOND row, URL is still '/?editId=&ts=179...719' (unchanged), banner=False, glucose field empty, header 'Nuova Misurazione'. First edit of a fresh session works (because the URL does change from no-param to editId=X), but every subsequent edit (and edit-after-cancel) fails. All other flows verified PASS: (1) Add 2 measurements via web-date-input/web-time-input defaults — OK, both appear in Storico. (2) First edit of row 1 — banner shown, header 'Modifica Misurazione', form prefilled (glucose='90' for Notte row), save label 'Aggiorna Misurazione'. (3) Update glucose 90→200 — Storico row count unchanged (2 → 2), value updated, no duplication. (4) Past date entry via web-date-input GG/MM/AAAA + web-time-input HH:MM — works, section header shows the correct past day. (5) Delete flow: delete-button opens delete-confirm-modal, cancel-delete-button cancels (count unchanged), confirm-delete-button removes the row. (6) export-pdf-button triggers window.print on web without crash; with empty data the 'Nessun dato da esportare' info toast is shown. No React Native red screen; the pre-existing 'shadow*' and 'props.pointerEvents deprecated' warnings are from react-native-web internals and are not actionable.

ui_bugs.component: Storico -> Inserimento edit navigation (second edit regression)
ui_bugs.issue: REGRESSION NOT FIXED. router.navigate({pathname:'/', params:{editId: item.id, ts: String(Date.now())}}) in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/storico.tsx:127-131 is a no-op when the Inserimento tab is the already-focused route — Expo Router does not update useLocalSearchParams, so the prefill useEffect in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:91-105 never re-fires. Evidence: URL stays at '/?editId=&ts=<old>' after the 2nd tap; banner stays hidden; glucose field empty; header remains 'Nuova Misurazione'. Same failure after a successful Update AND after pressing cancel-edit-button.

integration_issues.flow: Repeated edit from Storico (2nd edit, edit-after-update, edit-after-cancel)
integration_issues.issue: Root cause is Expo Router dropping params on in-route navigation. Recommended fixes (any ONE): (a) Replace router.navigate with router.setParams({editId: item.id, ts: String(Date.now())}) from Storico — but setParams only applies to the current route, so you'd need a tiny shared signal (zustand store or React context) that Inserimento watches. (b) Use router.replace({pathname:'/', params:{editId,ts}}) — may still dedupe. (c) BEST: lift the 'editing id' into a lightweight store (Zustand or React Context) and have Inserimento read from it inside a useFocusEffect, dropping URL params entirely. (d) Alternatively, in index.tsx after save/cancel, call router.replace('/') (without any params) instead of setParams({editId:''}) so the next navigate(...) with params is a real param transition — but on web this depends on expo-router actually diffing params; in practice (a) or (c) is more robust.

action_items: FIX HIGH regression: switch edit navigation off of URL params. Simplest robust fix: create a small Zustand store (or React Context) exposing { editingId: string | null, requestEdit: (id)=>void, clearEdit: ()=>void } in /app/frontend/src/measurements.ts (or a new /app/frontend/src/edit-store.ts). In Storico onPress of the pencil, call requestEdit(item.id) then router.navigate('/'). In Inserimento, replace the useLocalSearchParams-based useEffect with a useFocusEffect (or plain useEffect on editingId) that prefills whenever editingId changes. On save/cancel, call clearEdit().
Keep testIDs 'edit-button-<id>', 'delete-button-<id>', 'edit-banner', 'cancel-edit-button', 'save-measurement-button' unchanged for regression testing.
After fix: retest the exact scenario: add 2 measurements -> edit row1 -> save -> edit row2 (must open edit mode) -> cancel -> edit row1 (must open edit mode again).
Optional nice-to-have: on web, constrain web-date-input to disallow future dates (match native maximumDate).
critical_code_review_comments: The ts+lastTsRef mechanism in index.tsx:67-69 and :91-105 is correct in isolation; the bug is that the ts param never arrives because router.navigate to the same route doesn't flush new params in expo-router web.
useUpdateMeasurement (src/measurements.ts:55-67) is correct — in-place list.map by id guarantees no duplication, verified end-to-end.
StoricoScreen deletion flow (storico.tsx:100-106, 221-250) is clean and works as expected.
Minor: on web onSave re-parses dateText/timeText at save time (index.tsx:156-164) — good, text is the source of truth.

success_rate.frontend: ~83% (5/6 flows pass; repeated-edit regression still blocking)

seed_data_creation: Ephemeral AsyncStorage/localStorage measurements created during the run; cleared via window.localStorage.clear() at start of each test cycle.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reproduce by: (1) clear localStorage, load app, (2) add any 2 measurements, (3) open Storico, tap edit-button on row A — this works, URL becomes '/?editId=A&ts=T1'. (4) change glucose, tap save-measurement-button. URL becomes '/?editId=&ts=T1'. (5) open Storico, tap edit-button on row B — URL stays '/?editId=&ts=T1' (UNCHANGED). edit-banner is NOT visible, form is empty. Same if step 4 is replaced by 'tap cancel-edit-button'. Fix must stop relying on router params to carry the editId across tabs.
rca_of_issue: Expo Router's router.navigate({pathname:'/', params:{...}}) is a no-op when '/' is already the current (focused) route on the (tabs) stack on web — the URL and useLocalSearchParams are NOT updated, so even a changing 'ts' never reaches InserimentoScreen's prefill useEffect. The iteration_2 fix (adding ts + lastTsRef) assumes the new params will arrive; they do not. Mitigation: don't carry edit intent via URL params — use a shared store (Zustand/Context) read inside a useFocusEffect, then call router.navigate('/') just to switch tab.
